name: Isle of Man
prevalence_note: Isle of Man Bank publishes delivery-scam warnings, and the Isle of Man Government's Cyber Security Centre runs seasonal online-safety advice on shopping and parcel tricks.
cross_border_note: The Isle of Man uses UK numbering (+44, area code 01624), so UK-based scam campaigns reach Manx phones the same way as mainland ones.

scams.name: Fake delivery text on the Isle of Man
scams.name_en: Parcel text with a payment link, as warned by Isle of Man Bank and the Cyber Security Centre
scams.signals_en: A text says a parcel bound for the island needs a fee or new delivery slot and links to a page collecting card data.
scams.legit_en: Isle of Man Bank warns about delivery-scam texts; check with the carrier through its own website.
bait_tactics: Ask which Isle of Man Post Office branch holds it, then ask for the item reference twice
Say the porch is the usual drop spot and no fee was ever needed before
